title: Renewal History and the Small Business Electricity Supply Renewal Rate: Points of Judgement
content:
**Renewal-history adjustment.** For a Small Business Electricity Supply renewal accepted on or before the contract end date, an agreement whose bill carries no renewal loyalty credit and whose current term did not begin by automatic renewal is renewing for the first time and takes 0.04 cents per kWh off the renewal rate; an agreement whose bill carries at least one renewal loyalty credit takes 0.02 cents off; any other agreement takes nothing off.

## Records read

- The agreement's bill: whether any renewal loyalty credit line has ever been posted on it.
- The agreement record: whether its current term began by automatic renewal.

## Points of judgement

| Renewal loyalty credit on the agreement's bill | Current term began by automatic renewal | Renewal-history adjustment |
|---|---|---|
| none | no | 0.04 cents per kWh off (renewing for the first time) |
| at least one | no | 0.02 cents per kWh off |
| at least one | yes | 0.02 cents per kWh off |
| none | yes | nothing off |

## Hypothetical agreements

- A shop in its first fixed term, never renewed and never automatically renewed: 0.04 cents off.
- An office that renewed explicitly once before, its bill carrying that earlier renewal loyalty credit: 0.02 cents off.
- A salon whose current term began by automatic renewal and whose bill carries no renewal loyalty credit: nothing off.
